notes:
Add Unbound Brain, a room where models debate (#2)

* feat: add Unbound Brain, a room where models debate

Several models draft, critique and revise until they converge, then a moderator pins the answer. Ollama is the default, local OpenAI-compatible servers are discovered on common ports, and cloud keys stay in the OS keychain.

Co-authored-by: Chris Lightfoot <akindabigdeal@gmail.com>

* feat: add a Debate mode with turns and a keep vote

Each model opens with its best answer, takes one turn reviewing every other point, then votes keep or drop. The scoreboard shows who proposed each point and how it was voted. The moderator may assemble the final answer only from the points that were kept.

Co-authored-by: Chris Lightfoot <akindabigdeal@gmail.com>

* feat: setup wizard, send-to-app, photo analysis, and suggestions

A first-run wizard installs or finds a local model, accepts free and paid keys into the keychain, and picks a team. Answers can be handed to apps that are actually installed, and only when you click. Photos and video stay local unless you allow a vision model to see them. Suggestions email the maintainer through a Supabase function that holds the Resend key, never the app.

Co-authored-by: Chris Lightfoot <akindabigdeal@gmail.com>

* feat: play the owner intro once, then open setup

The 30 second H.264 intro is bundled with the app. The first launch plays it full window with sound, fades in and out, and can be skipped with Space or Esc. If the webview blocks sound, it keeps playing and asks for a tap. A seen flag stops the autoplay after that, and Watch intro in Settings plays it again.

Co-authored-by: Chris Lightfoot <akindabigdeal@gmail.com>

* fix: run on macOS 10.15+ (no regex lookbehind, small WebKit shims), steer old Macs past Ollama, Windows smoke test, suggestions URL in CI

* release: 0.6.0 (Unbound Brain); above the 0.5.0 test build already on some PCs
